title: He hears you

verses.text: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.

caption:
You are not speaking into an empty room.

Scripture keeps saying the same quiet thing: He hears. Not only the polished words, but the tired ones, the half finished ones, the ones you can barely get out. Call to Him and He answers.

1 John 5:14, Psalm 34:17, Jeremiah 33:3 (BSB)

Save this for the night the words run out.
Send it to someone who has been asking a long time.
